$comment: Single source of truth for the ultimate_cursor_settings allowlist of the FREE plugin. Consumed by Ultimate_Cursor_Settings_Schema for both REST writes and browser output. 'topLevel' fields exist only on the stored option root; 'config' fields exist on the root (single-cursor format) and inside each cursorConfigurations[] entry. Types map to sanitizer callbacks in class-settings-schema.php. A field missing here is DROPPED from REST writes and from output. An add-on (the Pro plugin) registers its own fields through the 'ultimate_cursor_cursor_field_manifest' filter — this file must only list what the free plugin itself offers. 'legacyOutput' lists keys older versions stored and the runtime still reads: they pass through to the browser but can no longer be written.
